assessment.nobel_worthiness: Inflation and its account of primordial structure transformed cosmology and made sharply testable predictions.
assessment.attribution: Guth initiated inflation, while Starobinsky and Mukhanov made essential independent conceptual and perturbative contributions; credit remains intrinsically distributed.
assessment.maturity: CMB observations strongly support the central framework, though they do not uniquely establish a particular inflationary model.
uncertainties: The underlying inflaton physics and a unique model remain unknown.
Andrei Linde also has a major claim to recognition.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: WMAP made precision cosmology a quantitative science and provided decisive evidence for the standard cosmological picture.
assessment.attribution: The listed leaders represent mission, instrument, and scientific interpretation, although a space mission necessarily rests on a large collaboration.
assessment.maturity: Its measurements have been extensively checked and extended by later observations.
uncertainties: Assigning three individuals for a broad mission requires careful assessment of leadership roles.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The double pulsar provided an exceptionally clean strong-field laboratory for gravitation and relativistic dynamics.
assessment.attribution: The discovery and subsequent precision timing have identifiable leading contributors in the listed trio.
assessment.maturity: Long-baseline timing has produced durable, increasingly precise tests of general relativity.
uncertainties: Its significance is strongest as confirmation of general relativity rather than discovery of new gravitational physics.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Stable binary-black-hole simulations were indispensable to extracting physics from gravitational-wave observations.
assessment.attribution: Pretorius, Baker, and Campanelli were central to the breakthrough formulations, with important parallel contributions elsewhere.
assessment.maturity: The methods have been repeatedly validated against gravitational-wave signals and are now foundational to the field.
uncertainties: The achievement is computational and collective, making the boundary of individual credit difficult.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Quantum key distribution established a profound operational use of quantum mechanics and launched quantum communication.
assessment.attribution: BB84 and E91 give the listed pioneers unusually clear foundational claims.
assessment.maturity: The principles are experimentally mature and have driven a substantial field, despite practical limitations.
uncertainties: Real-world security depends on device assumptions and implementation details beyond the ideal protocols.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The recollision picture made high-harmonic generation intelligible and underpins attosecond science.
assessment.attribution: The listed theorists made closely connected, recognizable contributions to the model and its quantum description.
assessment.maturity: The mechanism has abundant experimental support and has enabled major advances in ultrafast measurement.
uncertainties: Experimental pioneers of high-harmonic generation may also merit consideration.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Geometric and gauge phases revealed a deep physical content in quantum phase and have broad experimental consequences.
assessment.attribution: Aharonov and Berry are the clear names for their respective effects, but the ballot combines distinct discoveries.
assessment.maturity: Both effects are extensively observed and embedded in modern quantum physics.
uncertainties: The conceptual and historical case for a single combined prize needs closer scrutiny.
Additional co-discoverers may have valid attribution claims.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Gauge/gravity duality is among the most influential conceptual developments in modern theoretical physics.
assessment.attribution: Maldacena's formulation is pivotal, while the conceptual lineage is broad and cannot be represented straightforwardly by three names.
assessment.maturity: It is a powerful and productive theoretical framework, with many internal successes and applications.
uncertainties: There is no direct empirical confirmation of the duality as a description of nature.
The appropriate attribution, including other foundational contributors, is highly contested.
